description: Cleans old VS Code Server versions, obsolete extensions, and cached downloads in the remote environment.
configuration.title: Remote SSH Cleaner
configuration.cleanUserCache: Delete the complete ~/.cache directory. Disabled by default.
configuration.cleanOldServers: Delete server versions not referenced by lru.json.
configuration.cleanOldExtensions: Keep only the newest version of each extension.
configuration.checkOnStartup: Check at startup whether a cleanup is required.
configuration.startupDelaySeconds: Delay in seconds before the automatic startup check.
